about.tagline: Inzwi rako. Chiteshi chako. Kwose kwose.
about.whoWeAreBody: {{appName}} ichiteshi cheredhiyo chemazuva ano chinokuunzira zviratidziro zveLive, ma podcast akasarudzwa, nhau dzinokurumidza, uye kubatana zvakananga nevaPresenter nemapurogiramu awunoda — zvose muApp imwe chete. Kunyangwe uchiteerera stream yeLive, uchiendesera mberi chikamu chePodcast usina intaneti, kana kukumbira rwiyo rwaunoda, tiri pano kukuchengetedza wakabatana nenzwi renharaunda yako, kwose kwaunoenda.
about.missionBody: Kuzivisa, kunakidza, uye kubatanidza vateereri vedu kuburikidza neredhiyo yeLive inonakidza, ma podcast edu chaiwo, uye nhau dzenguva chaiyo — zvichipihwa nekunaka nekuvimbika kunotarisirwa nevateereri vemazuva ano, pane chero divhaisi yavanosarudza.

search.emptyDescription: Wana mapurogiramu, vaPresenter, nhau, ma podcast nezvikamu.

slide1.title: Redhiyo yeLive, nguva dzose
slide1.description: Teerera Modern Voice Radio nekunaka kwakanyatsojeka, paLive maawa 24/7, kwose kwaunenge uri.

slide2.title: Ma podcast panguva yako
slide2.description: Ramba uchiteerera zviratidziro zaunoda, dhawunirodha zvikamu, uye tangazve pawakasiya.

slide3.title: Usarasikirwe nechinguva
slide3.description: Wana zviziviso zvekukurumidza zvenhau dzinokurumidza, mapurogiramu aunoda, uye ma podcast matsva.

comingSoon.title: Zviri kuuya
comingSoon.description: Tichiri kuzvigadzirira. Dzokera nokukurumidza — zvichasvika munguva pfupi.
comingSoon.podcasts: Ma podcast edu ari kugadzirwa. Munguva pfupi uchakwanisa kuteerera nekudhawunirodha zvikamu zvizere pano.
comingSoon.downloads: Kudhawunirodha kuti uteerere usina intaneti kuri kuuya pamwe chete nema podcast edu. Uchakwanisa kuchengetedza zvikamu wozoteerera usingashandisi data.
comingSoon.equalizer: Sarudzo dzeruzha dziri kuuya. Parizvino, kuridza kunoshandisa marongero eruzha edivhaisi yako.
comingSoon.map: Mepu yechiteshi iri kuuya. Panguva ino, shandisa kero nenhamba dziri pamusoro apa.
